info.name: TeleMed API
info.description:
TeleMed / AiroEmed REST API.

Import **TeleMed_Local.postman_environment.json** (or use this collection’s variables) and select the environment.

**External integrators:** see `docs/INTEGRATION.md`. Full route catalog: `docs/API.md`.

Seed password for all users: `password123`

**Customer / doctor / pharmacy flows:** run **Auth → Login Customer** (or Doctor / Pharmacy) first.

**Admin catalog flows:** run **Auth → Login Admin** first.

**OTP / register:** use Auth → Signup Email OTP / Mobile Login OTP requests (mock OTP often `1234` in local).

**Payments:** dummy `POST …/payment` or Razorpay order + verify under **Purchases (Checkout)**.

`postman.json` is an alias of this collection for easy sharing.

request.description: Revokes the opaque refresh token (204). Clears local session on clients.

Fires consultation.assigned via unified notification service (persists inbox row + SSE). Keep **SSE Stream** (or the doctor portal) connected. Then call **List Notifications** to assert the inbox row.
Unified inbox for the authenticated user (doctor/pharmacy/customer). Use after **Test SSE (Self)**.

item.name: Content
item.description: Public CMS content. **Homepage** loads hero, how-it-works, social proof, and curated featured medicines/concerns/reviews.

item.name: Carts
item.description:
Website **Add to Cart** uses `POST /v1/users/carts/items` — backend finds or creates the user's single active cart.

**Get Active Cart** (`GET /carts`) returns `{ cart }` with items, files, and `paymentContext`, or `cart: null` if empty.

**Get Cart** by id is optional (checkout deep link only).

Checkout: **Purchases (Checkout)** folder.

item.name: Purchases (Checkout)
item.description:
Checkout after **Carts → Add to Cart**. Payment SUCCESS locks cart and **auto-creates consultation**.

Customer app calls `POST .../payment` with `outcome: SUCCESS` only.

request.description: Returns keyId + orderId (amount in paise) for Razorpay Checkout.
Verify checkout signature and fulfill purchase (creates consultation).

item.name: Questionnaires
item.description:
Customer app intake uses **sessions** only (`POST` → `GET health-profile` → `PATCH answers` → `GET session` → `POST submit`).

Questionnaire flow is embedded in the session response — no catalog `/v1/catalog/questionnaires/*` calls.

item.name: Consultations
item.description:
Customer consultations are **read-only** from the website — created automatically on successful payment (doctor assigned by cart category).

Doctor actions are under **Doctor Portal** folder.

item.name: Orders
item.description:
Customer account orders under `/v1/users/orders/*`.

- **List** — each order has `displayStatus` (`label`, `tone`, `phase`, `timestamp`) for list badges and filters.
- **Detail page** — `GET .../:orderId/detail` returns slim payload: `order`, `timeline`, `delivery`, `invoiceAvailable`. Use `timeline` for track status (including return rails).
- **Documents** — use `/documents/receipt` and `/documents/invoice` for downloads; detail only exposes `invoiceAvailable` boolean.
- Customer order id = **purchase id** (`order.id` in list), formatted `#AH-{id}` in UI.

request.description:
Account order detail + track timeline.

Response: `{ order, timeline, delivery, invoiceAvailable }`.

- `order` — slim fields only (`id`, `status`, `amount`, `displayStatus`, return window, `items[]`).
- `timeline` — `{ displayStatus, steps[] }` with optional return rail on step `return`.
- `delivery` — recipient + address lines.
- `invoiceAvailable` — `true` when invoice doc status is `ISSUED` (download via `GET .../documents/invoice`).
Manual path when `COURIER_PROVIDER=manual`. For mock/shiprocket use **Pharmacy → Create Order Shipment (Provider)**.
Cancels provider booking when still cancellable, then sets local CANCELLED.
Returns `{ labelUrl }`. Mock returns HTML data URL; Shiprocket returns CDN URL.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Unauthenticated provider callbacks. Courier webhook uses optional shared secret header `x-courier-webhook-secret` (env `COURIER_WEBHOOK_SECRET`). Always expects HTTP 200.

request.description: Simulate Shiprocket/Mock tracking. Set `courierAwb` from Create Order Shipment (Provider). Try statuses: `In Transit`, `Out For Delivery`, `Delivered`, `Canceled`. For returns set `"is_return": true`.
Server-to-server. Requires valid x-razorpay-signature over raw body. ENABLE_RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK=true to process.

item.name: Pharmacy
item.description:
Pharmacy staff portal under `/v1/pharmacy/*`. Run **Auth → Login Pharmacy (Central)** first.

**Order IDs:** Responses include `purchaseId` and `customerOrderDisplayId` (`#AH-{purchaseId}`) on orders, returns, and shipments. Internal fulfillment id is `id` / `orderId` (`pharmacy_order.id`).

**Inventory** list items include `availableQty` (stock minus reserved).

**Fulfillment exceptions:** `GET /fulfillment/unfulfillable` — paid orders that could not be shipped; `POST /fulfillment/:id/initiate-refund` marks refund pending.

**Returns:** `POST /returns/:id/status` with `{ status }` — `approved` | `rejected` | `pickup_scheduled` | `picked_up` | `received_at_pharmacy` | `refunded`. Rejection after receipt uses `received_at_pharmacy` → `rejected`.

**Courier (Shiprocket/Mock):** Set API `COURIER_PROVIDER=mock|shiprocket`. Flow: **Get Courier Status** → **Get Order Shipping Rates** → **Create Order Shipment (Provider)** → **Get Shipment Label** / webhook tracking. Returns: **Get Return Shipping Rates** → **Schedule Return Pickup (Provider)**. Pharmacy must have `courierPickupLocation` set in admin.

**Realtime (SSE):** `GET /events` stream + `POST /events/test` self-test. Open the stream (or pharmacy portal), then run **Test SSE (Self)**.

request.description: Long-lived Server-Sent Events stream for the authenticated pharmacy. Keep open while testing. Events: pharmacy.order_received. Prefer **Test SSE (Self)** to fire a sample event.
Fires pharmacy.order_received to the logged-in pharmacy. Keep **SSE Stream** (or the pharmacy portal) connected. Response includes deliveredLocal / connectedLocal.
Each order includes `purchaseId`, `customerOrderDisplayId` (`#AH-{purchaseId}`), and internal pharmacy `id`.
`{ courier: { enabled, provider, providerId } }` — enabled when COURIER_PROVIDER is mock|shiprocket.
Serviceable couriers + rates for pharmacy order. Saves first `courierCompanyId`.
Requires COURIER_PROVIDER=mock|shiprocket and pharmacy `courierPickupLocation`. Body uses rate `courierCompanyId`.
Each shipment includes `orderId` (pharmacy order) plus `customerOrderDisplayId` when linked to a purchase.
Each return includes `orderId` (pharmacy order) and `customerOrderDisplayId` (`#AH-{purchaseId}`) when linked.
Reverse serviceability (customer → pharmacy). Saves `courierCompanyId`.
Provider reverse pickup. Prefer over manual courier/tracking when courier integration is enabled.
Manual pickup when COURIER_PROVIDER=manual. For mock/shiprocket use **Schedule Return Pickup (Provider)** after **Get Return Shipping Rates**.

item.name: Customer Journey (run in order)
item.description:
End-to-end **customer app** flow — only APIs called by `telemed-customer`.

1. Run **Auth → Login Customer (Priya)** first.
2. Steps **0–2e** are public catalog (no auth).
3. Rx checkout: **3a–3e** questionnaire (`POST sessions` → `GET health-profile` → `PATCH answers` → `GET session` → `POST submit`). Flow is embedded in the session — no catalog questionnaire flow API.
4. **Add to Cart** auto-creates/reuses cart; consultation is created on payment SUCCESS.
5. Step **0** sets `medicineId`, `concernId`, `categoryId` from homepage.
6. Steps **10–11** (orders) run only after a prescription is fulfilled and an order exists.

request.description: Slim account detail: `{ order, timeline, delivery, invoiceAvailable }`. Track UI reads `timeline.steps`.
